# Prone [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#ProneCondition)*

While you have the Prone condition, you experience the following effects.

***Restricted Movement.*** Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your [Speed](../Movement/Speed.md) (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can't right yourself.

***Attacks Affected.*** You have [Disadvantage](../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md) on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md) if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.
